title: Backflow test notice: turn the letter into a closed checklist
description: A notice-response page for property owners and managers who need to distinguish the due date, exact assembly, eligible tester, failed-test path, and proof of submission.
prompt: Which fields on this notice control the response and closeout?
answer: The notice is the controlling workflow document: it identifies the account, assembly, deadline, tester rule, and submission route. A completed visit does not close the notice without the required record and filing evidence.
urgency: Escalate an address or device mismatch, missing official contact, or deadline that leaves no repair-and-retest window.
diagramAlt: Backflow notice workflow from identifying the assembly to retaining submission confirmation
identifiers: Notice account and assembly fields must match the real site asset.
Tester eligibility and report submission can be owned by different parties.
A failed outcome must remain linked to the notice through retest and filing.

choices.label: I need an eligible tester
choices.detail: Use the official program list where one is provided.

choices.label: The test failed
choices.detail: Keep the failed report and route to a documented repair and retest scope.

choices.label: I need to submit a completed report
choices.detail: Confirm the actual portal, recipient, and confirmation requirements.

steps.title: Establish the governing record
steps.body: Record the issuer, due date, device, credential rule, and portal instructions.

steps.title: Define the complete work
steps.body: Verify the device and access before scheduling the correct test path.

steps.title: Document completion
steps.body: Retain the final result and confirmation with the original notice.

safeChecks: Use the exact property and assembly record before authorizing work.
Confirm official program and manufacturer information for the decision.
Keep the final result and submission evidence together.
stopConditions: The notice and site asset do not match.
No official submission confirmation can be produced.
notThisDevice: A notice is a workflow document, not a diagnosis of device condition.
A tester directory is not proof that a tester is eligible for every program.
A generic upload form is not necessarily the issuer?셲 reporting portal.
evidenceNote: This path is governed by the official utility or authority requirement, then by exact manufacturer documentation for the identified assembly.
